s.en: Child of the storm (rain and wind): ×
is shackled and can't use abilities.

s.zh: 只有成年的风暴巨人能召唤风暴。
s.en: Only adult storm giants can summon storms.

s.zh: 要朝一个方向放出闪电。
s.en: Must release the lightning in a direction.

s.zh: 召唤了风暴：雷雨将持续一天，雷电会劈向敌人。
s.en: summoned a storm: thunderstorms will last a day, and lightning will strike enemies.
Must be used on a map.

s.zh: 捏碎了风暴宝珠：乌云翻滚，雷雨将持续一天。
s.en: crushed the storm orb: dark clouds roll in, and thunderstorms will last a day.
